question: 2026학년도 1학기 IE419-00(서비스데이터사이언스)와 2026학년도 1학기 SWCON104-01(웹/파이선프로그래밍)의 정규 수업시간이 일주일에 총 몇 분 겹쳐? 시험 일정은 제외하고 요일별 겹치는 구간만 합산해줘.
pred_sql:
WITH c1 AS (
    SELECT ts.day, ts.start_time, ts.end_time
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN class_times ct ON co.offering_id = ct.offering_id
    JOIN time_slots ts ON ct.time_slot_id = ts.time_slot_id
    WHERE co.year = 2026 
      AND co.semester = '1' 
      AND co.course_code = 'IE419' 
      AND co.section = '00'
),
c2 AS (
    SELECT ts.day, ts.start_time, ts.end_time
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN class_times ct ON co.offering_id = ct.offering_id
    JOIN time_slots ts ON ct.time_slot_id = ts.time_slot_id
    WHERE co.year = 2026 
      AND co.semester = '1' 
      AND co.course_code = 'SWCON104' 
      AND co.section = '01'
),
overlaps AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.day,
        MAX(c1.start_time, c2.start_time) AS overlap_start,
        MIN(c1.end_time, c2.end_time) AS overlap_end
    FROM c1
    JOIN c2 ON c1.day = c2.day
    WHERE MAX(c1.start_time, c2.start_time) < MIN(c1.end_time, c2.end_time)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(
        (CAST(SUBSTR(overlap_end, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(overlap_end, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)) - 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(overlap_start, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(overlap_start, 4, 2) AS INTEGER))
    ), 0) AS total_overlap_minutes
FROM overlaps;
